decks.notes: The key concept of this Golgari Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Glissa Sunslayer to further control the board. The key concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent's life total using low-cost and high-damage creatures, combined with direct burn spells. Monastery Swiftspear and Bloodthirsty Adversary provide early threats that can quickly grow in power. Play with Fire and Lightning Strike offer versatile removal options and direct damage to the opponent. Kumano Faces Kakkazan adds additional burn damage and card advantage. Squee, Dubious Monarch and Feldon, Ronom Excavator provide card recursion and value. Mishra's Foundry and Nahiri's Warcrafting offer extra utility. Charming Scoundrel and Goddric, Cloaked Reveler provide additional threats that can overwhelm the opponent. Witchstalker Frenzy adds an additional aggressive threat while also offering card draw.
